### Paul Tillich on courage

Paul Tillich (1886–1965) approaches courage within existential theology. Faith is ultimate concern—what claims us unconditionally—risking idolatry when finite things are absolutized. Being-itself names God beyond theistic objectification; symbols participate in what they point to. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets courage most directly—useful for searches such as “paul tillich quotes on courage.”
